summary: Enhance your business acumen with our Data Science and Machine Learning course. Learn to leverage data for strategic decision-making and drive growth.
lede: Data science and machine learning help business teams turn organizational data into evidence for growth decisions. Designed for professionals working across business strategy and technical execution, the course covers preparing and exploring data with Python and SQL, designing A/B tests, and building predictive models for tasks such as revenue forecasting and customer churn. It also introduces clustering for customer segmentation.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for professionals who sit at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution, requiring the skills to turn data into a competitive advantage.
audience: Product Managers using usage data to drive
modules: Data Acquisition and SQL for Business Intelligence
Statistical Inference and A/B Testing Strategy
Time Series Analysis for Demand Planning
Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) and AI Ethics
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of business mathematics and experience using Microsoft Excel for data analysis. No prior programming experience in Python or SQL is required, though familiarity with logical reasoning and data structures is beneficial. All technical tools and libraries will be introduced during the course.
topics: Data science & machine learning in practice
